item.title: Dusty Springfield
item.description: Mary Isobel Catherine Bernadette O’Brien, from West Hampstead, London, became Dusty Springfield and sang Black American music with a devotion and a vocal intelligence that earned the respect of the artists she idolized.

item.title: Downtown scene
item.description: The five years when downtown New York's separated undergrounds — punk's children, disco's survivors, the galleries, and the arriving Bronx — stopped staying in their lanes and shared the same rooms.
